scope: Checksummed bounded legacy snapshot preview, canonical domain restore and journalled project plus task coordination
acceptance: A bounded gzip tar snapshot is inspected without filesystem extraction and requires one safe root, regular files only and a complete SHA-256 manifest
Preview and commit fail closed for changed bytes, unsafe paths, links, unknown manifest shapes, unsupported collection versions, fields, tombstones and domains
Reviewed people records map into the canonical PeopleStore in one SQLite transaction with a durable replay-safe receipt
Authenticated HTTP and console file selection expose verified preview, explicit supported-domain coverage, reviewed commit and persisted receipts
Version-1 memory, link, idea and journal records retain stable conflict IDs, source identity, timestamps, tags, URLs and structured provenance in one canonical KnowledgeStore transaction
One version-1 project is staged and atomically published per archive with its stable relationship ID and replay receipt in the canonical project tree
Version-1 bookmark buckets become canonical manual collections and link bucket IDs become validated relational memberships in the same KnowledgeStore transaction

Version-1 inbox records preserve stable capture IDs, meaningful routing state and immutable classification history; routed records require an existing or same-transaction canonical knowledge destination
One version-1 admin action or tracked thread is crash-safely published as a canonical native Task with stable identity, mapped work state, embedded replay receipt and validated canonical references
One version-1 song retains its stable identity, typed repertoire metadata and practice schedule through the canonical RepertoireStore import transaction

Every declared song attachment must be present under the archive songbook path with matching path, type, size and SHA-256; text is validated as UTF-8 and binary bytes are materialized as immutable version-1 native artifacts

A durable prepared, artifacts_ready and complete journal coordinates the repertoire transaction with owned artifact publication, exact replay and restart rollback while preserving pre-existing identical artifacts
A fresh home reopens restored canonical people, knowledge, project, task, repertoire, artifact and receipt state through their production stores
A mixed archive containing exactly one project and one admin action or tracked thread publishes through a bounded prepared, project_ready and complete recovery journal
Same-archive thread references bind to the restored stable project ID; caught failures compensate only unchanged coordinator-owned project and task records through canonical delete operations
Restart recovery rolls forward an unchanged interrupted coordinator plan, exact replay deduplicates its receipt, and edited or replaced canonical targets fail closed while preserving the journal
Standalone project and task receipts created before record fingerprints remain replay-compatible only when archive identity, review token and freshly derived canonical body all match
limits: This sub-slice supports only version-1 people, projects, admin, threads, ideas, journals, memories, links, buckets, inbox and songs collection records; every other archive domain, relational dump and future schema is rejected.

People, song and knowledge archive families remain separate; projects may be coordinated only with exactly one admin action or tracked thread, and project, task and song families remain limited to one record.

A song archive is recoverable across its authoritative SQLite and artifact stores through a durable rollback journal; every mixed authoritative-store matrix other than project plus task remains rejected.
Shared durability inventory, packaged backup inclusion and the final aggregate fresh-home restore journey remain owned by the root integration slice.
